$comment: REQ-STARTUP-143: the maintainer-review table of reviewed exceptions, read by tools/notices/notices.mjs. An entry lets a shipped dependency that carries no license text pass notices validation; a licence file that only names the licence, only points elsewhere for it (Apache-2.0's per-file notice, MPL-2.0's Exhibit A, 'See the LICENSE file'), or only attributes (NOTICE, AUTHORS) is not license text, and is still reproduced beside the entry (OQ-75). Each entry carries: component (the name as the notices file prints it), versions (an exact version, or space-separated comparators such as ">=1.0.0 <2.0.0"), license (the identifier claimed for it), whyNoText (why no license text is obtainable), reviewer (the maintainer who reviewed it), reviewedOn and expires (YYYY-MM-DD, the review not after the day the generator runs, the expiry at most 365 days after the review). An entry covers a dependency only while its version is inside the range and the expiry has not passed; otherwise it is treated as no entry at all. Adding an entry is a reviewed change made by a maintainer, never by the generator or an agent. Two optional parts of such an entry (OQ-75, 2026-10-23): licenseText, {file, source}, the claimed licence's text as the reviewer obtained it outside the component, kept under tools/notices/licenses/ verbatim and held to the identifier by LICENSE_TEXT_CHECKS in notices.mjs; and embedded, a list of {work, license, file}, the licence of a separately licensed work the component vendors, read from the installed component at file. Both are reproduced under their own heading and neither counts as the component's own licence text. A second kind of entry (OQ-74, 2026-10-23), with covers "identifier", supplies the identifier of a dependency that ships its licence text and declares none: it carries whyNoIdentifier and licenseFile (the shipped file, as the component's licence files name it, which must be that licence's text) in place of whyNoText, and covers neither a missing text nor a declared identifier. The entries reviewed 2026-10-23 were written by an agent on the owner's delegation, as their reviewer field says (docs/architecture/open-questions.md, OQ-74 and OQ-75; first-release-plan.md section 6, O-11).
